message.content: Call AskUserQuestion once with two single-select questions about a team offsite (headers Venue, Food), each with 4 options whose labels are long phrases of 8 to 12 words with a one-sentence description. No other text.

questions.question: Which venue should we book for the team offsite?

options.label: Rustic mountain lodge with fireplaces and hiking trails nearby
options.description: A secluded retreat about two hours away that encourages unplugging and outdoor team activities.

options.label: Modern downtown coworking loft with rooftop terrace and city views
options.description: A central, easy-to-reach space with fast Wi-Fi, breakout rooms, and evening skyline access.

options.label: Beachfront resort conference room overlooking the ocean at sunset
options.description: A relaxed coastal setting that blends focused sessions with free time on the sand.

options.label: Converted vineyard barn surrounded by rolling hills and gardens
options.description: A charming countryside venue with open floor space and optional guided tasting tours.

questions.question: What food arrangement should we plan for the offsite?

options.label: Fully catered buffet with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options
options.description: A professional caterer handles every meal so the team can stay focused on the agenda.

options.label: Local food truck rally parked right outside the venue
options.description: Several rotating trucks give everyone a casual variety of cuisines to choose from.

options.label: Hands-on group cooking class led by a professional chef
options.description: The team prepares lunch together as a built-in collaborative bonding activity.

options.label: Daily meal stipend for exploring nearby restaurants in small groups
options.description: Each person gets a budget to eat out, mixing up groups to meet new colleagues.
